scope: Fixed-bank modal audit, not a new source model, evolving repick simulation or reference fit.

protocol.purpose: Identify the existing E2 upper modal decay without source-spectrum or reference fitting.
protocol.inputs: Frozen v5 production bank snapshots and coupled-pole equations; immutable source 6c83ff453ff7ac346598e8e73367ced128a90838.
protocol.validation: Reproduce every v5 n=1..6 pole before extending. Enumerate modes by unwrapped unit-circle loop phase, then solve the same exact coupled characteristic equation.
protocol.decomposition: Record loop component magnitudes, phase group delay and exact modal T60. Allpass group delay changes traversal rate despite unity unit-circle magnitude. A band slope is not a modal T60.
protocol.restrictions: No production edits, new coefficients, audio renders, reference-mask changes or threshold changes. No shipping decision from this audit alone.
